_comment_register: How POST /farmers reaches the registry: ingest (default, ingest-data) or intake (intake form, section by section). intake also needs farmer_registry_master_data_url and farmer_registry_ingest.intake_form_id.
_comment_read: Reads use the OpenG2P Staff API (POST + request_header/request_body envelope): register-data/get_subject_record, get_tab_records, search_in_a_register; updates become change-requests/create_change_request. No per-endpoint path config.
_comment_ingest: Farmer register / intake form / tab ids. register_id and intake_form_id are optional: when omitted they are discovered from register-metadata/get_all_registers and intake-form-metadata/get_all_intake_forms (form mnemonic containing farmer_registry_intake_form_contains) and cached for an hour. The dev values are shown for reference.
_comment_keycloak: Prefer staff-user IAM login when username and password are set (callback cookies X-Access-Token and X-CSRF-Token; login_provider_id defaults to 1). Otherwise client_credentials (token_url, client_id, client_secret) or farmer_registry_api_key. Put username and password only in site_config.json.
_comment_environments: Documentation only. The client reads the top-level keys from site_config.json and does not load _environments.
